title: Space Invaders
summary: The classic arcade shooter is the intended game. The supplied archive contains different firmware; the correct shooter reference is still needed.
notes: Confirmed target: the classic 1978 Taito Space Invaders arcade shooter.

The supplied Space_Invaders_Arcade_ROM_EN.zip contains Bally 1980 pinball firmware, not the shooter. Its chip names and checksums were matched to primary MAME source; the original bytes remain preserved.
Obtain a correct, lawful shooter reference before reverse-engineering and validating the native rewrite. No playable implementation exists yet.
keyboard: Planned: left/right movement and fire after original input timing is documented.
controller: Planned: D-pad / left stick movement and A to fire; physical controller testing remains required.
